hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '\.(env|env\.[a-z]+)"'; then echo 'BLOCKED: .env file edits are not allowed — manage secrets outside the repo' >&2; exit 2; fi
if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(package-lock\.json|pnpm-lock\.yaml|yarn\.lock)"'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Lock file edits are not allowed — use the package manager instead' >&2; exit 2; fi

FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"file_path":\s*"[^"]+"' | grep -oE '/[^"]+'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|json|css|scss|md)$'; then if echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/mobile/'; then cd /Users/marcusklein/dev/RecoveryConnect/mobile && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q '/functions/'; then cd /Users/marcusklein/dev/RecoveryConnect/functions && npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi

FILE=$(echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -oE '"file_path":\s*"[^"]+"' | grep -oE '/[^"]+'); if echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'functions/src/'; then cd /Users/marcusklein/dev/RecoveryConnect/functions && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; fi
